service_name.description: Service name — required for identification; defaults to 'fondu'

input_files.description: List of Macintosh font input files to process; each item must specify path; resource_fork is optional metadata flag

force_overwrite.description: If true, use -force flag to overwrite existing files without prompting

prompt_before_overwrite.description: If true, use -inquire flag to prompt before overwriting (takes precedence over -force)

show_output.description: If true, use -show flag to print each created file to stdout

recode_to_latin1.description: If true, use -latin1 flag to recode Mac Roman bitmap fonts to Latin-1

track_postscript_files.description: If true, use -trackps flag to follow FOND references and process external PostScript files

generate_afm_files.description: If true, use -afm flag to generate Adobe Font Metrics (AFM) files from FOND + PostScript data
